description:
Achieve clear, healthy-looking skin with this curated blemish-prone skincare set featuring CeraVe, La Roche-Posay, and Vichy. This powerful trio combines the best of these renowned brands to cleanse, treat, and hydrate your skin for a visibly refined complexion.

This set includes:

CeraVe Blemish Control Cleanser (236ml): This gentle yet effective cleanser, formulated with salicylic acid, helps to clear breakouts, reduce blackheads, and minimize pores without disrupting the skin's protective barrier. It's ideal for daily use and helps to prevent new blemishes from forming. Key ingredients include salicylic acid, ceramides, and niacinamide.

La Roche-Posay Effaclar Serum Ultra Concentré: This concentrated serum targets imperfections with a powerful blend of exfoliating acids and niacinamide. It helps to reduce the appearance of blemishes, refine skin texture, and even out skin tone. The lightweight formula absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue. Key ingredients include salicylic acid, glycolic acid, and LHA (lipo-hydroxy acid).

Vichy Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream: This hydrating night cream replenishes and strengthens the skin barrier overnight, leaving it feeling soft, supple, and more resilient. Formulated with Vichy Volcanic Water and Hyaluronic Acid, it provides deep hydration and helps to soothe irritation. This cream provides the essential moisture your skin needs while allowing the active ingredients in the other products to work their magic.

Key Benefits:

Reduces blemishes and breakouts: The combination of salicylic acid and other exfoliating acids helps to unclog pores, reduce inflammation, and prevent future breakouts.

Refines skin texture: Exfoliating acids gently remove dead skin cells, revealing smoother, brighter skin.
Improves skin tone: Niacinamide helps to reduce redness, hyperpigmentation, and post-blemish marks for a more even complexion.

Hydrates and soothes: Vichy Minéral 89 provides essential hydration and helps to calm irritated skin.

Suitable for blemish-prone skin: All products are formulated for sensitive, blemish-prone skin.

How to Use:

Cleanse: Apply CeraVe Blemish Control Cleanser to damp skin, gently massage, and rinse thoroughly.

Treat: Apply La Roche-Posay Effaclar Serum Ultra Concentré to clean, dry skin, focusing on areas prone to blemishes.

Hydrate: Apply Vichy Minéral 89 Moisture Recovery Night Cream as the final step in your evening skincare routine.
